title: A hand-written python3 call is classed by purpose in its call row
goal: The call.tool row of a bare python3 or python3 -c command carries a closed purpose class (kb read, backlog edit, test run, parse, other) taken from the script's first tokens by a deterministic rule, with no script text stored, so a census separates what hand-written scripts do; a planted script holding a secret-shaped string shows nothing of it in the row.
